Container.Name: nfs-haven-server
Container.Overview: NFS Haven server: one address for the NFS Haven app on Apple TV and Mac. It serves your own copies of the games' data (one folder per game, plus optional mod sets and HD packs) with fast, resumable downloads, keeps every game's saves with version history (shared between Apple TV and Mac), and runs a lobby so network games can be joined over Tailscale.[br][br]Drop your own disc images and official updates into the Inbox (the nfs-haven share over SMB): the server recognises them by their contents, keeps them read-only in Sources and builds each game's data by itself (Porsche Unleashed disc + 3.5 update, The Need for Speed SE CD). Watch it on the status page (Web UI, add ?token=YOUR-PASSWORD).[br][br]Set a Password and enter the same one in the app. LAN and Tailscale only: never port-forward this server to the internet.
Container.Requires: An Unraid share named nfs-haven (SMB export on) for the Games, Inbox, Sources and Staging folders. Your own copy of each game: its disc image (and official update), or its files.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port the app and the status page use. Never port-forward it to the internet: LAN and Tailscale only.

Config.Name: Password
Config.Description: The password the app sends with every request. Enter the same value in the app (Extras › Network, or the Apple TV Game Data screen); the status page takes it as ?token=. Use a long random string.

Config.Name: Server name
Config.Description: The name the app shows for this server.

Config.Name: Games
Config.Description: One folder per game: porsche/original/, nfsse/original/ (built by imports, or copied in by hand), GAME/mods/NAME/ (mod sets), GAME/hd/ (HD packs). Imports only ever replace GAME/original.

Config.Name: Inbox
Config.Description: Drop a game's disc image (.img, .bin + .cue, .iso) or an official update here. It is recognised by its contents, moved to Sources and the game rebuilt; anything not recognised stays here and is listed on the status page.

Config.Name: Sources
Config.Description: The imported disc images and updates, one folder per game, kept read-only with their checksums. Re-import on the status page rebuilds a game from these.

Config.Name: Staging
Config.Description: Where an import builds and checks a game before swapping it into Games. Needs room for one game (about 600 MB); empty between imports.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Saves and their versions, caches and import logs. Covered by the normal appdata backup.

Config.Name: Save versions
Config.Description: Earlier copies kept of each save file (plus the newest of each of the last 30 days).

Config.Name: Lobby timeout
Config.Description: Seconds without a heartbeat before a hosted network game leaves the lobby.
